questions.question: What is the average of all numbers between 11 and 80 which are divisible by 6?
questions.solution:
First number to be divisible by 6 in this range = 12

Last number to be divisible by 6 in this range = 78

This is an AP with difference = 6

Let the total numbers in this AP be n

⇒ Average = Sum of AP/total numbers

⇒ Average = [n/2(last term + first term)]/n

⇒ Average = (last term + first term)/2

∴ Average = (12 + 78)/2 = 45

questions.question: If Cosec θ = 25/7, then what is the value of Cot θ?
questions.solution:
We know that cot²θ + 1 = cosec² θ

⇒ 625/49 -1 = cot²θ

⇒ (625 - 49)/49 = cot²θ

⇒ cot²θ = 576/49

∴ cotθ = 24/7

questions.question: The simple and compound interest that can be earned in two years at the same rate is Rs. 1500 and Rs. 1575 respectively. What is the rate (% per annum) of interest?
questions.solution:
Let P be the Principal and R be the rate of interest

SI = (P × R × T)/100 = 1500

⇒ PR = 150000/2

⇒ PR = 75000

⇒ P = 75000/R

CI = P(1 + R/100n)ⁿt - P = P(1 + R/100)² - P = 1575

⇒ P(1 + R/100)² - P = 1575

⇒ 75000/R(1 + R/50 + R²/10000) -75000/R = 1575

⇒ 1500R + 7.5R² = 1575R

Dividing by 7.5

⇒ R² - 10R = 0

⇒ R(R -10) = 0

∴ R = 10 as R can’t be 0

questions.question: If inflation is measured as increase in price index and the price index was 200 in the beginning of 2015 in country D then what is the index at the end of 2016?
questions.solution:
Given: price index at the beginning of 2015 = 200

Price index at end of 2015 = 200(1 + 2/100) = 200 × 1.02 = 204

∴ Price index at end of 2016 = 204(1 + 5/100) = 204 × 1.05 = 214.2

questions.question: Sum of four times a fraction and 6 times its reciprocal is 11. What is the fraction?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sum of four times a fraction and 6 times its reciprocal is 11.

**Calculations:**

Let the fraction be a

So, 4a + 6/a = 11

⇒ 4a² - 11a + 6 = 0

⇒ 4a² - 8a - 3a + 6 = 0

⇒ 4a(a - 2) - 3(a - 2) = 0

⇒ (4a - 3)(a - 2) = 0

∴ a = 3/4 and 2

questions.question: Excluding stoppages, the speed of a bus is 72 kmph and including stoppages, it is 60 kmph. For how many minutes does the bus stop per hour?
questions.solution:
Given: Speed of bus excluding stoppages = 72km/hr

Speed of bus including stoppages = 60km/hr

∴ Total time the bus stops in 1 hr = [(72 - 60)/72]hr = (12/72)hr = 1/6 hr = 10 minutes

questions.question: What are the co-ordinates of the centroid of a triangle, whose vertices are A(1, -5), B(4, 0) and C(-2, 2)?
questions.solution:
Centroid of a Triangle is the intersection of all the medians

Let the co-ordinates of centroid be (x, y)

⇒ x - coordinate = (x₁ + x₂ + x₃)/3 = (1 + 4 -2)/3 = 1

⇒ y - coordinate = (y₁ + y₂ + y₃)/3 = (-5 + 0 + 2)/3 = -1

So, (x, y) = (1, -1)

questions.question: What is the reflection of the point (5, 2) in the line x = -3?
questions.solution:
To find: reflection of the point (5, 2) in the line x = -3

⇒ the equation of line is: x + 3 = 0

The formula for finding the image of a point (x₁, y₁) to the line ax + by + c = 0 is given by:

(x - x₁)/a = (y - y₁)/b = -2(ax₁ + by₁ + c)/(a² + b²)

Here, a = 1, b = 0 and c = 3

So, we have

(x - 5)/(1) = - 2(5 + 3)/(1) and (y - 2) = 0

⇒ x - 5 = -16 and y = 2

∴ x = -11

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4e982a5fcfb52688b20873ba6cf25c43fb2d0d0a53c55a21d12a132ad4029ad.png] 

The distance of line x = -3 from the reflection will be the same as the distance from the original point.

Distance of x- coordinate of line from the original point = 5 + 3 = 8

The distance of x- coordinate of the line from the reflected point 

= - 3 - 8 = -11 ( As it is on the other side of the axis)

The y- coordinate is constant in the line x = -3, therefore y- coordinate will be remain the same.

The refection point = (-11, 2)

If a³ + b³ = 19 and ab = -6 , then what is the value of a + b?
questions.solution:
We know that: (a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b)

⇒ (a + b)³ = 19 + 3(-6)(a + b)

⇒ (a + b)³ = 19 -18(a + b)

Let the value of (a + b) be c. So, we have

⇒ c³ + 18c - 19 = 0

∴ Here, c = 1 satisfies the above equation

questions.question: A trader had 960 kg of rice. He sold a part of it at 20% profit and the rest at 8% profit, so that he made a total profit of 12%. How much rice (in kg) did he sell at 8% profit?
questions.solution:
Let the amount of rice he sold at 20% profit be a

Then, the amount of rice he sold at 8% profit will be (960 - a)

Given: total profit = 12%

⇒ a(1 + 20/100) + (960 - a)(1 + 8/100) = 960(1 + 12/100)

⇒ 1.2a + 1036.8 - 1.08a = 1075.2

⇒ 0.12a = 1075.2 - 1036.8

⇒ a = 38.4/0.12

⇒ a = 320

So, the amount of rice he sold at 8% profit will be (960 - a)

∴ The amount of rice he sold at 8% profit = 960 - 320 = 640

questions.question: A, B and C can finish a job working alone in 72, 24 and 36 days respectively. In how many days they can finish the job if they worked together?
questions.solution:
Let the total work be a

⇒ Work done by A in 1 day = a/72

⇒ Work done by B in 1 day = a/24

⇒ Work done by C in 1 day = a/36

⇒ Work done by all 3 in 1 day = a(1/72 + 1/24 + 1/36) = a/12

∴ Days taken by all 3 to do total work = a/(a/12) = 12 days

questions.question: Slope of the line AB is -4/3. Co-ordinates of points A and B are (x, -5) and (-5, 3) respectively. What is the value of x?
questions.solution:
Slope of a line joining 2 points (x₁, y₁) and (x₂, y₂) is (y₂ - y₁)/(x₂ - x₁)

So, -4/3 = [3 - (-5)]/(-5 - x)

⇒ 4/3 = 8/(5 + x)

⇒ 20 + 4x = 24

∴ x = 1

questions.question: ΔABC is right angled at B. If ∠A = 60°, then what is the value of 1/√3 Cosec C?
questions.solution:
We know that: Sum of all the angles of a triangle = 180°

⇒ ∠A + ∠B + ∠C = 180°

⇒ ∠C = 30°

To find: 1/√3CosecC

⇒ (1/√3)/sinC

⇒ (1/√3)/sin30°

⇒ (1/√3)/(1/2)

⇒ 2/√3

questions.question: D and E are points on side AB and AC of ΔABC. DE is parallel to BC. If AD : DB = 2 : 5 and area of ΔADE is 8 sq cm, what is the ratio of area of ΔADE : area of quadrilateral BDEC?
questions.solution:
Here ΔADE and ΔABC are similar triangles

Given: AD/AB = 2/7

So, DE/BC = 2/7

Let DE be 2b. Then, BC will be 7b

Make an altitude from A on BC and mark the points P and R when it cuts DE and BC respectively.

So, ΔAPD and ΔARB are also similar triangles

⇒ AP/AR = 2/7

 Let AP be 2b. Then, AR will be 7b

Since,

Ar of ΔADE = 1/2 × 2a × 2b = 2ab

Ar of ΔABC = 1/2 × 7a × 7b = 49ab/2

So, area of quadrilateral BDEC = 49ab/2 - 2ab = 45ab/2

⇒Required ratio = 2ab/(45ab/2)

∴ Required ratio = 4 : 45
